The chibi retains Belyn’s medium-height clearly muscular construction, broad shoulders, developed torso, arms and legs, and stable grounded posture without added softness.
The tattooed upper arms and forearms preserve the source muscular girth; wrists and hands remain coherent, empty, and proportionate without generic ballooning.
The red-copper-auburn long loose hair preserves the source swept-back part, crown mass, side silhouette, and shoulder-length fall.

The plum-gray broad-collared divided tabard, layered waist wrap, loose trousers, wrapped ankles, geometric tattoos, cheek scar, medicine pouch, and polished shoes all remain recognizable and no new anchor is introduced.
The crown-to-chin head unit occupies approximately 29% of standing height, about 3.4 heads tall, below the required 32–36% head share and outside the 2.75–3.1-head range.
Exactly one complete figure is present with the entire long hair silhouette, both empty hands, and both feet comfortably inside the canvas margins.
The grounded three-quarter ready-idle pose has a compact, clearly separated head, torso, arms, tabard, and legs that read cleanly at combat-icon scale.
The image remains ordinary mortal workwear with no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, affinity cue, floating, frame, star, number, UI, logo, watermark, or text.
